==Notes==
*It is possible to kill this boss to capture its elite without completing the Gate of Desolation mission. Joko's Domain is accessible via [[Basalt Grotto]] and the path to this boss does not need to go through sulfurous sand if the player heads south to the resurrection shrine with a Mandragor Hunt bounty and then heads northwest to come up south of the boss. 
*Uses a staff until an enemy is within approximately half of the aggro bubble of her.
